test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22nd November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Opponent
solution:
The correct answer is **'Supporter'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Opponent** means a person who plays against somebody.

 ** • Example- **She is a formidable opponent in the race for senator.

 
• Marked option **Supporter** means people who support someone or something.

 ** • Example- **He's a staunch supporter of controls on government spending.

 
• So, it is clear that the words **'Opponent'** and **'Supporter'** are opposite in meaning.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A professor** means a university teacher of the highest level.
 
• **A mentor** means an experienced person who advises and helps somebody with less experience over a period of time.
 
• **A presenter** means a person who introduces a television or radio programme.
